guide.problem: Keep a search tree from becoming a long chain.
guide.design: Rotations preserve key order while reducing height imbalance. A standard ordered container avoids hand-maintained balancing.
guide.invariant: Ordering and stored heights agree after each rotation; balance stays within the stated bound.
guide.failure: Updating heights before reconnecting children leaves stale metadata. Sorted insertion into an unbalanced tree can produce linear height.
guide.trace: A right rotation makes the old left child the root and preserves the middle subtree.
guide.maintenance: Test all rotation shapes and verify both values and structure.
